name: refunds
title_zh: 退款前先查资格再动手的保险丝
tagline_zh: 手滑下单后悔了？先让 skill 查清订单状态和规则，确认能退才调退款接口，不让你白跑一趟还惹客服。
tagline_en: Regret a purchase? This skill checks order status and policy first, then calls the refund API only when it's safe.
desc_en: Check refund eligibility and use the refund-order tool safely
why_zh: 把「能不能退」和「怎么退」拆成两步，资格不符就停下说明原因，而不是直接调接口撞一鼻子灰。
why_en: Separates eligibility check from the refund call — it halts with a reason if you don't qualify, instead of blindly hitting the.
limit_zh: 只认订单接口返回的字段判断资格，不覆盖平台外退款、争议申诉或人工客服流程；调工具前需已有订单号。
limit_en: Only judges eligibility from order API fields; no marketplace disputes, appeals, or human CS. Requires an existing order ID and a supported order.
title_en: Check refund eligibility before you pull the trigger
